content.text: The logs clearly show latency spikes correlate with slow upstream calls to pricing.io-internal.svc, which is an internal dependency owned by checkout-platform. No deployment changes in the window explain this.

hypotheses.subject: pricing.io-internal.svc
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's latency degraded because its internal dependency io-pricing (pricing.io-internal.svc) started responding slowly (~1500ms per basket-total call, saturating nearly all requests), and io-shop's own code, config, and deployments were unchanged.

supporting_evidence.claim: slow upstream call - pricing.io-internal.svc took 1500ms for /v1/shoppers/shopper-29137-6-0/basket-total (200 of 200 requests)
slow upstream call - pricing.io-internal.svc took 1500ms for /v1/shoppers/shopper-5644-2-0/basket-total (200 of 200 requests)
slow upstream call - pricing.io-internal.svc took 1500ms for /v1/shoppers/shopper-44719-12-10/basket-total (200 of 200 requests)
p50_ms jumped from 44 to 1545 and p95_ms from 213 to 1717, coincident with the onset
io-pricing: internal, owned by checkout-platform, at pricing.io-internal.svc - What a shopper's basket comes to once their discounts are applied. Called while the account page renders

hypotheses.summary: If io-pricing turns out not to be the true root and instead io-shop's own resource usage or code is at fault, no evidence of a leak or deployment was found in the reviewed window, so this is offered only as a fallback with no support.
